name: transfer_penalty
description: Excess catch returned and 50% penalty transferred to community fund by verifier

prompt.template:
As the verifier, you must transfer any excess catch penalty to the community fund.

The lake currently holds about {stock_kg:.0f}kg of biomass.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{"penalty_amount": <number>, "excess_catch_returned": <boolean>, "reasoning": "<in character>"}
